text: {"status":"CONFLICT","claims":[{"text":"Uploading company information classified Internal or above to a personal cloud-storage account is prohibited.","evidence_id":"E1","quote":"Uploading company information classified Internal or above to a personal cloud-storage account, such as a personal Dropbox, personal Google Drive or personal OneDrive, is prohibited."},{"text":"Confidential and Restricted information must never be stored in personal cloud storage.","evidence_id":"E2","quote":"Confidential and Restricted information must never be stored in personal cloud storage."},{"text":"Confidential and Restricted information may only be stored in company-managed systems approved by Information Security.","evidence_id":"E3","quote":"Confidential and Restricted information may only be stored in company-managed systems approved by Information Security."},{"text":"Confidential information includes customer personal information and customer financial information.","evidence_id":"E4","quote":"It includes customer personal information, customer financial information, non-public financial results, employee records and proprietary source code."},{"text":"Sharing Confidential information, including confidential customer information, with a third party requires approval from the data owner after the Vendor Security Assessment has been passed.","evidence_id":"E5","quote":"Sharing Confidential information, including confidential customer information, with a third party requires approval from the data owner after the Vendor Security Assessment has been passed."}],"conflict_evidence_ids":["E1","E2"],"conflict_note":"E1 prohibits uploading company information classified Internal or above to a personal cloud-storage account, while E2 allows Internal information in a personal cloud-storage account when working remotely if the account has multi-factor authentication."}
